stem: An engineer at Whitmore Energy manually adjusted an already-managed resource through the AWS console and now wants Terraform's own state updated to match, without changing any real infrastructure. Which plan mode accomplishes that?
rationale: -refresh-only mode updates Terraform's own state and output values to match changes made outside Terraform, without proposing any change to real infrastructure. -destroy previews tearing everything down, the opposite of the goal here. -out only saves a computed plan to a file; it does not change what the plan reconciles. -target only narrows which resources a plan covers; it does not change what kind of plan is produced.
